description: NaTi₂BiO₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmm2 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.79 Å. Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-2.46 Å. Bi is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.27 Å) and two longer (2.35 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Bi atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaTi₂Bi trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ti, and one Bi atom.
